technical-summary: rad0045 (diagnostic, untested, experiment expert-route-replay): --expert-route-replay FILE replays a route recorded by rad0044. New op router_topk_replay in libr4d (router_topk's row function with the selection skipped; weights from the run's own logits over the forced experts), rad_route_replay_load ABI call, per-rank device table, document-start lookup, fail-closed record and pass validation, tape off and fused routers skipped while replaying; manifest field engine.tuning.expert_route_replay (contract amendment 22). Verified on Flash-Next TP2: replayed expert counts equal the record's in all 48 layers; self-replay KLD 0; with the route fixed KLD vs bf16 is chunk-128 0.0076, bf16_i8 0.0074, bf16_fp8 0.0084, fp8 0.0097 (0.037-0.040 without replay).
user-summary-candidate: Added a diagnostic that replays a recorded expert route, so KV cache quality on Flash-Next can finally be compared without routing noise.
